tags.warm: Rounded, smooth, low-mid weighted; easy on the ears
tags.clean: Transparent: adds little colour of its own
tags.rhythmic: Works in time with the song (stutter, chop, steps)
tags.keys: Piano, electric piano, organ-like keyboard sounds
tags.drums: Drum and percussion kits or voices
tags.percussion: Tuned or untuned hits that are not a full kit
tags.acid: Squelchy resonant bass lines with slides
tags.subtractive: Oscillators into a filter and envelopes
tags.granular: Plays a wave as many tiny overlapping grains
tags.physical-model: Models a struck or plucked resonating body
tags.polyphonic: Plays chords: several voices at once
tags.eq: Shapes the tonal balance by frequency band
tags.filter: Passes or removes a range of frequencies, often with resonance
tags.compressor: Evens out level by turning loud parts down
tags.limiter: Hard ceiling on the peak level
tags.gate: Silences or lowers a signal below a threshold
tags.transient: Shapes the attack and sustain of hits
tags.glue: Bonds parts of a mix together with gentle compression
tags.sidechain: Can be keyed by another signal (ducking)
tags.saturation: Soft harmonic warmth and gentle overdrive
tags.distortion: Hard clipping, folding or other strong distortion
tags.bitcrush: Reduces bit depth or sample rate for lo-fi grit
tags.exciter: Adds harmonics for air and presence
tags.chorus: Thickens by mixing in detuned, delayed copies
tags.flanger: Swept short delay with feedback: jet-like comb sweep
tags.reverb: Simulated room, hall or plate space
tags.tempo-sync: Time or rate can lock to the song tempo
tags.learning: Teaches one synthesis method with few controls, each explained
tags.mix-bus: Suits the group or whole mix
tags.metering: Shows what the signal does; does not change it
tags.routing: Moves signals between machines or in and out of the app
tags.plugin-host: Hosts a plugin in the graph
tags.sequencer: Plays or edits note and pattern data
tags.arpeggio: Plays the notes of a chord one after another
tags.automation: Moves other machines' parameters over time
tags.notes: Holds notes or text for the song

AudioBlock.use_for: Lay recorded audio clips on a timeline inside the song, such as vocals or loops.

Bigyo Wood One.use_for: Wooden, mallet-like plucks and tuned percussion from a resonator struck by a noise or pulse burst.

BTDSys PeerChord.use_for: Turn single notes into chords and arpeggios played on other machines.

Connection Mixer Console.use_for: Balance the levels and pans of many machine connections from one console.

DAWControl.use_for: A control-only helper with a single bypass switch; it makes no sound of its own.

Dye Essence.use_for: Evolving pads, leads and basses from morphing wavetable or analog engines with unison and a built-in effects rack.

EasyRec.use_for: Record the audio passing through it into a wave slot, to resample a part or capture a take.

EnvelopeBlock.use_for: Draw parameter envelopes over patterns and play them into the machines they target.

FSM Chorus2.use_for: Stereo chorus with one to six taps for widening guitars, pads and synths.

FSM Infector.use_for: Thick detuned-saw leads, stacks and pads from a polyphonic synth with a multimode filter.

FSM KickXP.use_for: Tunable synthesised kick drums, from short thumps to long sub sweeps.

FSM PanzerDelay.use_for: Stereo multi-tap delay with per-tap pans and optional ping-pong for rhythmic echoes.

FSM PhatMan.use_for: Chorus and flanger with up to eight delay lines for wide, thick or jet-like modulation.

FSM Philthy.use_for: Resonant filter with its own LFO for sweeps and rhythmic filter movement.

FSM WahMan.use_for: Auto-wah: a resonant low-pass swept by an LFO, for funky, talking filter movement.

FSM WahManPro.use_for: Auto-wah with a choice of filter types and LFO shapes for more varied sweeps.

FSM WahPro2.use_for: Auto-wah with eight filters, including vowel-like ones, and many LFO shapes.

GuitarChordBox.use_for: Strum guitar-style chords from single notes, with per-string delays and humanising.

Info.use_for: Holds free text about the song in its own window; it does nothing to the sound.

Intoxicat ACloud15.use_for: Turn a wave into clouds of tiny grains for textures, drones and glitchy washes.

Jeskola Bass.use_for: Simple four-voice analog-style bass with a resonant filter and note slides.

Jeskola Bass 2.use_for: Monophonic bass with a resonant filter, envelope modulation and decay per track.

Jeskola Bass 3.use_for: Squelchy acid and rolling bass lines with accent and slide.

Jeskola Chorus.use_for: Basic chorus for thickening a mono or stereo source.

Jeskola Cross Delay.use_for: Stereo echoes whose feedback crosses between the left and right lines.

Jeskola Delay.use_for: Simple mono delay with up to eight taps, one per track.

Jeskola Distortion.use_for: Hard, buzzy threshold-and-clamp distortion for aggressive tones.

Jeskola EQ-3.use_for: Broad three-band tone shaping with two crossover points.

Jeskola Filter.use_for: Resonant low-, high- or band-pass for sweeps and tone shaping.

Jeskola Filter 2.use_for: Compact resonant filter with a selectable type.

Jeskola Live.use_for: Older performance helper steered by a Bar control; the Session View is the current way to launch patterns.

Jeskola Loop Recorder.use_for: Older helper for capturing loops of the audio passing through it.

Jeskola NiNjA dElaY.use_for: Multi-tap delay with a filter in the feedback loop, with tap lengths in ticks, ms or samples.

Jeskola Noise Generator.use_for: Noise bursts with an envelope and a colour from dark to white, for hats, risers and textures.

Jeskola Note Matrix.use_for: Edit notes on a grid in its own window.

Jeskola Organ.use_for: Drawbar-style organ tones from a set of footage-labelled harmonics.

Jeskola Raverb.use_for: Simple reverb with a time and high-frequency damping.

Jeskola Relativion.use_for: Shift and spread notes across a key range relative to a root note.

Jeskola Reverb.use_for: Mono reverb with early reflections and long tails up to about six seconds.

Jeskola Stereo Reverb.use_for: Stereo reverb with pre-delay and a high cutoff for a wider space.

Jeskola Tracker.use_for: Play waves from the song's wavetable as in the classic tracker workflow.

Jeskola Trilok.use_for: Synthesised kick drum fired by a trigger, with tone, decay and volume.

Jeskola Wave Shaper.use_for: Waveshaping distortion with a shape control per track.

Joachims Chopper 2.use_for: Triggered band-pass sweeps for stuttering, chopped filter moves.

Joachims Enceladus Tube EQ v1.use_for: Band boosts with tube-style drive for warm, coloured tone shaping.

Joachims Hyperion.use_for: Graphic EQ with a band for every third of an octave, for fine tonal correction.

Joachims Jupiter 3.use_for: Three-band compressor with stereo width and a beefing control, for mastering and bus work.

Joachims Mars filter 2.use_for: Thirteen distortion characters, from soft and round to tube-like and harsh.

Joachims Neptune 1.2.use_for: Spectral effects through an FFT: pitch shifting, bin scrambling and spectral boosting (adds latency).

Joachims Saturn 1.4.use_for: Lo-fi character in one: noise, bit and sample-rate reduction, detune, ring modulation and tube drive.

JumpLoop.use_for: Jump or loop the song position from a pattern, for live arrangement tricks.

kibibu Green Milk.use_for: Unison saw stacks and chord-shaped leads and pads with an envelope-driven filter.

KrimZon AY-3-8910.use_for: Raw three-voice retro sound-chip tones, with arpeggio-style sub-notes per track.

ManagedMultiIOEffect.use_for: A developer example of an effect with several inputs and outputs; not meant for music.

Matilde Tracker2.use_for: Tracker-style sample playback with tuning and quantised offsets.

mixIO.use_for: Per-track gain, width, mute and solo for balancing several inputs.

Modern Sequence Editor.use_for: Edit the song's sequence in its own window.

Neo Analyzer.use_for: Watch the spectrum of any signal, with peak hold, without changing it.

Neo Clipper.use_for: Shave peaks off drums, buses or the master with a hard, soft or knee clip.

Neo Comp.use_for: Level control and bus glue with four characters, sidechain and parallel mix.

Neo De-esser.use_for: Tame harsh s and t sounds in vocals and bright sources.

Neo Delay.use_for: Tempo-synced or free stereo delay: ping-pong, dub and tape-style echoes.

Neo Dither.use_for: Reduce bit depth at the very end of a master without audible quantisation noise.

Neo Drive.use_for: Add warmth, grit or fold-back harmonics with tape, tube, transistor, diode and folder models.

Neo Drums.use_for: A complete synthesised drum kit: kick, snare, clap, rim and hats with a pattern-friendly keymap.

Neo Ensemble.use_for: Chorus, flanger and phaser in one for width, movement and ensemble thickness.

Neo EQ.use_for: Eight-band parametric EQ for corrective cuts and broad tone shaping, minimum or linear phase.

Neo Exciter.use_for: Add air and presence per band with harmonics only, leaving the original signal untouched.

Neo Filter.use_for: Resonant ladder or state-variable filter with drive, envelope follower and tempo-synced LFO.

Neo FM6.use_for: Bells, electric pianos, FM basses and metallic percussion from six operators and many algorithms.

Neo Gate.use_for: Clean up noise, bleed and tails with a gate or downward expander, optionally keyed from a sidechain.

Neo Imager.use_for: Widen or narrow the stereo image per band while keeping the mix mono-compatible.

Neo Learn Additive.use_for: A teaching additive synth: build organs, hollow reeds, choirs and bells from sine partials with tilt, odd/even, comb and shimmer.

Neo Learn FM.use_for: A teaching FM synth: electric-piano tines, glass bells and growling basses from an exact modulator ratio, depth and feedback.

Neo Learn Formant.use_for: A teaching vowel synth: choirs, talking low voices and whispers from four formant filters that move across A, E, I, O and U, with tract size, Q and a talking envelope.

Neo Learn Granular.use_for: A teaching granular synth: ambient clouds, frozen textures and glitchy stutters from grain size, density, spray, octave shimmer and a trapezoid-to-Gaussian contour.

Neo Learn Physical.use_for: A teaching physical-modelling synth: marimbas, plucked strings, glass bowls and bowed or breathy tones from a material, a mallet-pick-bow exciter morph and a string-tube-bar-plate geometry.

Neo Learn Spectral.use_for: A teaching spectral synth: frozen pads, bell-like stretches and ghostly textures from one sample (built in or your WAV), analysed into partials and noise.

Neo Learn String.use_for: A teaching plucked-string synth (Karplus-Strong): harps, guitars, harpsichords and bells from a pick position, damping, a decay time that holds at any note, stiffness and sympathetic strings.

Neo Learn Subtractive.use_for: Learn subtractive synthesis: one oscillator, a sub and a resonant filter, every control explained.

Neo Learn Phase Distortion.use_for: A teaching phase-distortion synth: rubbery basses, digital plucks and glassy keys from a bent cosine with six read shapes, a decaying bend, a resonant sweep, ring modulation and a warm chorus.

Neo Learn Sampler.use_for: A teaching sampler: lo-fi keys, pads and drones from one sample (five built in, or your own WAV) with a start offset, a tone tilt, a crossfaded loop, vintage grit and a small room.

Neo Learn Vector.use_for: A teaching vector synth: evolving pads and textures from four sources at the corners of a diamond, a cursor that mixes them and an orbit that moves it by itself.

Neo Learn Wavefolder.use_for: A teaching wavefolder: metallic low tones, bongo-like plucks and sizzling leads from one to six folding stages, a symmetry offset, timbre FM and a low-pass gate.

Neo Learn Wavetable.use_for: A teaching wavetable synth: scan a table, bend the phase and let a slow motion sweep it for evolving pads and sync leads.

Neo Limiter.use_for: True-peak limiting for loudness and safe peaks on the master or a bus.

Neo Low End.use_for: Tighten, focus or mono-ise the bass and kick of a mix or master.

Neo Multiband.use_for: Control one frequency band at a time on buses and masters, compressing or expanding upwards.

Neo Poly.use_for: Warm analog-style polysynth for pads, basses, leads, plucks and chords.

Neo Sampler.use_for: Play the song's waves across the keyboard with key zones, loops and filters.

Neo Scope.use_for: Watch the waveform or stereo image of any signal without changing it.

Neo Strip.use_for: A full channel strip in one machine: gate, EQ, compression, drive and limiting.

Neo Tape.use_for: Tape character: soft saturation, bias and playback response to warm and glue a source or bus.

Neo Transient.use_for: Add or remove attack and sustain on drums, buses and masters.

Neo Utility.use_for: Gain staging and stereo fixes: trim, balance, width, bass mono, polarity and mid/side conversion.

Neo Verb.use_for: Algorithmic reverb with hall, room, chamber and plate spaces, freeze and a sidechain.

Neo Wave.use_for: Wavetable pads, sweeps, wobble basses and vowel-like leads from two warped table oscillators.

Oomek Aggressor 303.use_for: Acid bass lines: a resonant low-pass with envelope, accent and slide.

Oomek Exciter.use_for: Add presence and sparkle by blending high-passed, shaped harmonics back in.

Oomek Masterizer.use_for: Three-band limiter for the master, with input gain and per-band thresholds.

Pedal Chord.use_for: Turn each note in a track into a chord or arpeggio on a target machine, with many voicings.

Pedal Chorus.use_for: Four-voice stereo chorus that widens without much pitch wobble.

Pedal Comp.use_for: Feed-forward compressor with soft knee, lookahead and parallel mix for drums and buses.

Pedal Drum Matrix.use_for: A six-slot rack of drum effects (bit crush, drive, filters, comb, ring mod and more) to mangle drums.

Pedal EQ.use_for: Four-band parametric EQ with shelves, bells and per-band solo.

Pedal Filter.use_for: Stereo multimode filter with several slopes, drive and a comb mode.

Pedal FM.use_for: Four-operator FM keys, bells and basses with eight algorithms.

Pedal Gain.use_for: Stereo gain in percent with a smooth mute.

Pedal Gain Multi.use_for: A small mixer of up to 24 inputs, each with fader, pan and mono.

Pedal Gate.use_for: Noise gate with hysteresis, hold and peak or RMS detection.

Pedal Juno106.use_for: Warm six-voice analog-style pads, stabs and basses with a resonant low-pass.

Pedal LFO.use_for: Move another machine's parameter with a low-frequency wave.

Pedal M1.use_for: Two-oscillator sample synth for sampled keys, pads and layered textures.

Pedal MComp.use_for: Four-band compressor for gluing and balancing a bus or master.

Pedal Peer Control.use_for: Drive parameters of other machines from track values through mapping curves.

Pedal Plate.use_for: Smooth plate reverb for vocals and snares, with pre-delay and a low cut.

Pedal SH101.use_for: Monophonic basses and leads with sub oscillator, glide and a resonant ladder filter.

Pedal Shaper.use_for: Waveshaping distortion with several curves and a tilt EQ before the shaper.

Pedal Tracker.use_for: A sixteen-track tracker that plays waves from the song's wavetable.

Polac Audio In.use_for: Bring an audio input into the song as a source (older routing machine).

Polac Audio Out.use_for: Send audio to an output of the audio device (older routing machine).

Polac MIDI Bus II.use_for: Route MIDI between machines (older routing machine).

Polac MIDI In.use_for: Receive MIDI from a device into the song (older routing machine).

Polac Out.use_for: Output stage with volume and panning to the audio device (older routing machine).

Polac Out II.use_for: Output stage with a volume control to the audio device (older routing machine).

Polac VST 1.1.use_for: Host a 32-bit effect plugin in the graph (older host; Windows only).

Polac VSTi 1.1.use_for: Host a 32-bit instrument plugin in the graph (older host; Windows only).

QuickNote.use_for: A notes window for the song; it does nothing to the sound.

ReBuzz Audio In.use_for: Bring the audio device's input into the song.

ReBuzz Audio Out.use_for: Send what is connected to it to other outputs of the audio device.

ReBuzz Groove.use_for: Swing for the whole song: up to eight steps that stretch or squeeze each tick.

ReBuzz Midi Output.use_for: Send notes and controller changes from its tracks to a MIDI output device.

Rout 909.use_for: Complete synthesised drum machine with kick, snare, toms, rim, clap, hats, crash and ride.

Session Clip Player.use_for: An audio track for the Session View: play audio clips and record takes into them.

SpectrumBlock.use_for: A spectrum and level display with its own window.

TrackScript.use_for: A scripting helper that drives other machines from code in its own window; it makes no sound.

Yitten Mongoose.use_for: An older control machine steered by a Bar control; it makes no sound of its own.
